headline: BI: QRIS Transactions Surge 70%, Users Reach 71.9 Million
summary: QRIS digital payment transactions grew 70.95% year on year in October 2026, supported by 71.91 million users and 51.31 million merchants, Bank Indonesia reported.
why: QRIS is Indonesia's national quick-response payment standard, and its growth reflects the expansion of digital payments in the country's consumer economy.
original_headline: BI: Transaksi QRIS Melonjak 70%, Pengguna Tembus 71,9 Juta
